QuestInfo.name: [Nova] Early Bird Box
QuestInfo.0:
Get an Early Bird Box by eliminating monsters (including elite monsters) near your level.
Upon obtaining an Early Bird Box, you get a Nova Coin and a chance at winning the Lucky Meso.
